main_end.anchor: In this paper, we present LoRA-Pre

abstract_sentences.text: Modern optimizers like Adam and Muon are central to training large language models, but their reliance on first- and second-order momenta introduces significant memory overhead, which constrains scalability and computational efficiency.
In this work, we reframe the exponential moving average (EMA) used in these momenta as the training of a linear regressor via online gradient flow.

evidence.anchor: reframe ... as the training of a linear regressor

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this equivalence, we introduce LoRA-Pre, a novel low-rank optimizer designed for efficient pre-training.

Specifically, LoRA-Pre reduces the optimizer’s memory footprint by decomposing the full momentum matrix into a compact low-rank subspace within the online linear learner, thereby maintaining optimization performance while improving memory efficiency.
We empirically validate LoRA-Pre’s efficacy by pre-training models from the Llama architecture family, scaling from 60M to 1B parameters.
LoRA-Pre achieves the highest performance across all model sizes.

evidence.anchor: highest performance across all model sizes

abstract_sentences.text: Notably, LoRA-Pre demonstrates remarkable rank efficiency, achieving comparable or superior results using only 1/8 the rank of baseline methods.
Beyond pre-training, we evaluate LoRA-Pre’s effectiveness in fine-tuning scenarios.
With the same rank, LoRA-Pre consistently outperforms all efficient fine-tuning baselines.

Specifically, compared to standard LoRA, LoRA-Pre achieves substantial improvements of 3.14 points on Llama-3.1-8B and 6.17 points on Llama-2-7B, validating our approach’s effectiveness across both pre-training and fine-tuning paradigms.
Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/mrflogs/LoRA-Pre.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 EMA momentum 视为在线平方损失回归，再用 Newton 更新的低秩因子连续逼近 optimizer state；连续 subspace adaptation 被用来解释较低 rank 下的性能保持。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 EMA 等价式、第一/二动量压缩、Theorem 3.1 最终 update、数据/模型/rank 配置、Table 1-3 与 Figure 2-3，足以判断方法和主要相对结果。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Newton proof、完整 Adam/Muon algorithms、误差递推与收敛 theorem、Assumptions 1-3、β-γ sensitivity 移入附录；迁移保持方法可读性，但使复现和理论适用边界依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 把等价关系和压缩路径画成单图；Table 1 的四尺度表、Figure 2 的同轴 rank 曲线和 Table 3 的 Muon upper/lower references 共同承载决策。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 摘要/正文的 highest/consistently/all 强 claim 超过表格逐指标证据；Table 2 的 MATH-500 有例外，Table 3 的 second-best 差值口径亦不完全可由表面值复算。收敛保证依赖强低秩与 descent 假设，未被实验直接检验。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: optimizer-state compression 论文应先给出 state 的等价学习问题，再在同一比较中报告 rank/状态预算、动态机制、full/low-rank matched controls 和逐任务结果。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有显式状态更新和可定义压缩预算的优化器；没有清晰等价目标、只有单次点估计或状态非矩阵时，不能把 online regression/rank efficiency 外推为普遍机制。
